stories.title: 特朗普威胁对将 AI 数据中心建在美国之外的公司征收“巨额税”
stories.sourceTitle: Trump threatens ‘tremendous tax’ for moving AI data centers outside the US
stories.summary: 特朗普表示将对在海外建设 AI 数据中心的企业征收“巨额税”，而美国多地正限制新建数据中心申请。该表态可能影响 AI 基础设施的选址与成本。
stories.analysis: 数据中心选址被政治化，短期会增加企业海外布局的不确定性。
stories.sourceExcerpt: President Donald Trump promised to put a "tremendous tax" on companies that build data centers outside of the US, even as states and cities around the country are placing restrictions on new applications to build them. "We're not going to allow our companies t

stories.title: 芯片能扛住太空环境，太空数据中心的融资能扛住吗？
stories.sourceTitle: Chips can survive the space environment — can their financing?
stories.summary: TechCrunch 讨论太空数据中心融资难题：贷款方不愿让 SpaceX 把抵押品送入轨道。这关系到太空计算基础设施能否获得资本支持。
stories.analysis: 技术可行性与金融风险错配，融资结构是太空数据中心落地的关键瓶颈。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Lenders don't want SpaceX shooting their collateral into orbit. What does that mean for space data centers writ large?

stories.title: Outlook 宕机、全美航班停飞、银行与 iCloud 故障：科技系统遭遇“崩溃周”
stories.sourceTitle: The week everything fell apart
stories.summary: The Verge 回顾本周多起技术故障：Outlook 长时间宕机、25 年来第二次全国航班地面停飞、银行服务中断以及 iCloud 故障。它凸显关键数字基础设施的连锁脆弱性。
stories.analysis: 连续故障说明系统冗余和跨平台依赖风险需要重新评估。
stories.sourceExcerpt: There was a dayslong Outlook outage. A nationwide ground stop for only the second time in 25 years. Banks seemed to suddenly stop working. Even iCloud couldn't stay up and running. This week, it felt like the technological world simply collapsed. And it felt l

stories.title: Daniel Ek 投资 AI 研究者创办的聚变能源初创公司 Europa Fusion
stories.sourceTitle: Daniel Ek backs AI researcher’s fusion power startup. Here’s what they’re building.
stories.summary: Spotify 创始人 Daniel Ek 投资了由 AI 研究者创办的聚变能源初创公司 Europa Fusion；报道介绍其正在建造的技术。值得关注 AI 背景创业者进入能源硬科技。
stories.analysis: AI 人才与资本向聚变等硬科技溢出，但技术验证仍漫长。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Spotify founder Daniel Ek is backing Europa Fusion, a fusion power startup founded by an AI researcher. Here's what the startup is building.

stories.title: AI 与人类同时宣称解决 167 年历史的黎曼猜想
stories.sourceTitle: AI claimed a solution to the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis — and a human did, too
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道，一项 AI 驱动成果让数学家震惊，同时出现了竞争性的人类解法。黎曼猜想的验证与优先级成为焦点。
stories.analysis: 数学突破需同行验证，AI 与人类解法并行将考验学术认定机制。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Mathematicians are having their minds blown by the latest AI-driven result — and there's a competing human solution, too.

stories.title: Anthropic 数学家称借助 Claude 证明黎曼猜想
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
stories.summary: Anthropic 数学家 Levent Alpöge 声称在 Claude 帮助下证明了黎曼猜想，这一千禧年难题长期未被攻破。若验证通过，将是 AI 辅助数学的重大案例。
stories.analysis: 关键在可验证证明而非宣称，AI 在数学中的角色将从辅助计算走向猜想证明。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge claims he has proved the Riemann hypothesis, one of mathematics's most notoriously difficult problems, with the help of Claude, cracking a puzzle that has eluded some of the world's best mathematicians for decades. If veri

stories.title: OpenAI 公布对抗“对抗性蒸馏”的多层防护方案
stories.sourceTitle: Combatting adversarial distillation
stories.summary: OpenAI 介绍通过模型训练、安全防护、检测与执法相结合，防止模型能力被提取。这针对的是攻击者蒸馏模型能力的行为。
stories.analysis: 模型能力窃取成为商业化风险，防护需技术与政策并用。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI’s layered approach to adversarial distillation combines model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement to protect against capability extraction.

stories.title: Signal 限制 iOS 与 Android 截图，阻止 Gemini 和 Siri 读取屏幕内容
stories.sourceTitle: Signal is blocking Gemini and Siri AI from reading your screen
stories.summary: Signal 在 Android 和 iOS 上限制截图功能，以防止系统内置 AI 代理读取用户消息和屏幕数据。这反映端侧 AI 与隐私保护的冲突。
stories.analysis: 隐私应用被迫对抗 OS 级 AI，可能推动更严格的屏幕数据权限。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Signal is restricting the ability to take screenshots on Android and iOS devices in an effort to prevent AI agents from reading users' messages and other data. The agentic AI capabilities built into operating systems that analyze on-screen information to learn

stories.title: NVIDIA 黄仁勋离任风波发酵，财报仍显示健康增长
stories.sourceTitle: The fallout from Nvidia’s Jensen Huang scandal continues
stories.summary: TechCrunch 报道，NVIDIA 在处理 CEO 黄仁勋离任风波之际发布最新财报，业绩增长健康并承诺好时光继续。公司同时表示将停止销售部分产品。
stories.analysis: 领导层动荡与业务增长并存，市场将关注战略连续性和产品限制的影响。
stories.sourceExcerpt: In the midst of dealing with the fallout from its ouster of CEO Jensen Huang, Nvidia delivered its latest earnings report this week, with healthy growth and promises that the good times will continue. At the same time, the chipmaker said it will stop selling i

stories.title: 六款 AI 办公小工具：从记笔记到网络摄像头升级家庭办公室
stories.sourceTitle: Six AI-powered gadgets that could make your home office smarter
stories.summary: TechCrunch 推荐六款 AI 驱动的办公设备，包括笔记工具和网络摄像头等，用于提升居家办公效率。适合关注消费级 AI 硬件的产品趋势。
stories.analysis: AI 硬件仍以单点效率提升为主，生态整合比单品功能更关键。
stories.sourceExcerpt: From notetakers to webcams, here are six AI-powered gadgets to upgrade your workspace.

stories.title: Meta 的 Muse Charm 带屏 AI 设备或定价 300 美元
stories.sourceTitle: Meta’s Muse Charm might cost $300
stories.summary: 据 The Information 报道，Meta 计划将带屏幕、可与其 Muse AI 代理对话的 Muse Charm 定价为 300 美元。该设备由扎克伯格今年早些时候发布，市场关注其出货计划。
stories.analysis: 300 美元的带屏 AI 代理设备需证明使用场景，否则难逃配件化。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Meta is planning to price the Muse Charm, a little gadget with a screen that lets you chat with your Muse AI agent, at $300, according to The Information. CEO Mark Zuckerberg revealed the gadget earlier this year and said the company expected to ship the Charm

stories.title: Google 首页加入 AI 聊天侧边栏
stories.sourceTitle: Google is putting AI chats right on the homepage
stories.summary: Google 正在更新首页以加入 AI 搜索，产品副总裁 Robby Stein 展示了可展开侧边栏，用于查看和继续 AI 聊天。此举把 AI 对话入口提升到搜索首页层级。
stories.analysis: Google 在首页直接承接 AI 会话，意在防守搜索入口被聊天机器人分流。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Google is updating its homepage to include AI searches. In a post on X, Google's vice president of product, Robby Stein, shows how you can now open a collapsible sidebar to view and continue your AI chats. Based on the GIF shared by Stein, it looks like you ca

stories.title: Anthropic 登陆纳斯达克，首日开盘报 111.50 美元
stories.sourceTitle: Anthropic starts trading on Wall Street
stories.summary: Anthropic 正式在纳斯达克上市，股票代码 ANT，开盘价 111.50 美元，高于每股 83 美元的发行价；发行价对应公司估值约 1.5 万亿美元。这是 AI 公司资本化的重要节点。
stories.analysis: 公开市场将用营收和治理检验 AI 高估值，也为同行融资设定锚点。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Anthropic has officially gone public. It began trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker symbol "ANT" at $111.50 per share, up from its initial $83 per share price that put company's value at around $1.5 trillion. The listing comes nearly a month after Anthropic

stories.title: OpenAI 演示 PR scans：在拉取请求流程中查看扫描结果
stories.sourceTitle: See PR scans in action
stories.summary: OpenAI 发布 PR scans 的演示，展示如何在 pull request 工作流中审阅扫描结果。这指向代码审查与安全扫描的自动化集成。
stories.analysis: 把扫描结果嵌入 PR 流程，能减少开发者的切换成本。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Watch a walkthrough of PR scans and see how the presenter reviews scan results in a pull request workflow.

stories.title: OpenAI 发布 Daybreak Blue 上手指南
stories.sourceTitle: Get started with Daybreak Blue
stories.summary: OpenAI 发布 Daybreak Blue 的入门演示，介绍设置体验和开始使用的方法。原文未展开产品功能，重点在 onboarding。
stories.analysis: 产品落地越来越依赖上手体验，Daybreak Blue 的定位仍待更多信息。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Watch a walkthrough of onboarding to Daybreak Blue, with a closer look at the setup experience and how to get started.

stories.title: OpenAI 发布 Daybreak Red 部署参考架构，用于受监督安全调查
stories.sourceTitle: Deploying Daybreak Red
stories.summary: OpenAI 介绍 Daybreak Red 的参考架构，涵盖安全控制、部署设置和监控，面向受监督的安全调查场景。这显示其企业级安全用例的工程化思路。
stories.analysis: 安全调查场景对审计与监控要求高，参考架构有助于降低企业落地门槛。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Explore a reference architecture for supervised security investigations with Daybreak Red, including safety controls, setup, and monitoring.

stories.title: OpenAI 战略未来负责人 Dean Ball 谈“沉默共识”与 AI 治理
stories.sourceTitle: The Silent Consensus
stories.summary: OpenAI 战略未来负责人 Dean Ball 在《The Silent Consensus》中讨论更强 AI 如何重塑社会，以及人们如何保持对制度的控制。文章偏向 AI 治理与社会影响。
stories.analysis: AI 公司开始主动塑造治理叙事，制度控制权将成为政策争论核心。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Dean Ball, Head of Strategic Futures at OpenAI, examines how more capable AI could reshape society and how people can retain control of their institutions.

stories.title: OpenAI 详解 Codex 沙箱：在 macOS、Linux、Windows 上限制文件与网络权限
stories.sourceTitle: Inside the Codex sandbox
stories.summary: OpenAI 展示 Codex 如何在用户机器上运行命令，同时执行用户可控的文件系统和网络限制，覆盖 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。这关系到编码代理的本地安全边界。
stories.analysis: 编码代理要进入真实开发环境，沙箱权限控制是信任前提。
stories.sourceExcerpt: See how Codex runs commands on your machine while enforcing the filesystem and network limits you control across macOS, Linux, and Windows.

stories.title: OpenAI 用 GPT-6 Astra 优化 Jalapeño 芯片电路与 RISC-V 核心设计
stories.sourceTitle: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models
stories.summary: OpenAI 表示其模型优化了 Jalapeño 芯片中的电路，并改进了 RISC-V 核心设计，展示 GPT-6 Astra 在 AI 辅助芯片设计上的进展。这指向 AI 进入硬件设计流程。
stories.analysis: 用大模型优化电路设计若能复用，将缩短芯片迭代周期。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI models optimized circuits used in Jalapeño silicon and improved RISC‑V core designs, showing progress in AI-assisted chip design with GPT‑6 Astra.

stories.title: OpenAI 推出 Astra for Law，称在 24 个法律领域评测中排名第一
stories.sourceTitle: Astra for Law leads in legal intelligence
stories.summary: OpenAI 表示 Astra for Law 在覆盖 24 个法律领域的发布评测中排名第一，所有 ChatGPT Enterprise 客户现在可申请访问。法律成为企业 AI 的垂直竞争场景。
stories.analysis: 法律场景高价值但高准确率要求，评测第一需客户实践验证。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Astra for Law ranked first in a launch evaluation spanning 24 areas of law. Every ChatGPT Enterprise customer can now request access.

stories.title: OpenAI 与智利政府合作，推动公共部门 AI 应用与本地创业
stories.sourceTitle: Introducing OpenAI for Chile
stories.summary: OpenAI 宣布与智利政府建立合作，支持负责任地采用 AI、建设公共部门技能，并帮助本地初创企业开发 AI 应用。这是其在拉美市场的最新政府合作。
stories.analysis: 政府合作可同时带来公共部门采用和本地生态影响力。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI and the Government of Chile are partnering to support responsible AI adoption, build public-sector skills and help local startups develop AI applications.

stories.title: LVMH 媒体部门与 OpenAI 合作，用 AI 支持新闻并接入 ChatGPT
stories.sourceTitle: LVMH’s Media Division announces strategic partnership with OpenAI
stories.summary: LVMH 媒体部门与 OpenAI 宣布战略合作，计划用 AI 支持新闻业，并让其出版物通过 ChatGPT 更易获取。这显示媒体内容与 AI 分发平台的进一步绑定。
stories.analysis: 内容方与 AI 平台合作可换分发，但版权与流量分配仍是长期矛盾。
stories.sourceExcerpt: LVMH’s Media Division and OpenAI announce a partnership to support journalism with AI and make its publications more accessible through ChatGPT.

stories.title: OpenAI 启动首阶段嵌入式评估，联合 Apollo Research、METR 等独立审查对齐与监控
stories.sourceTitle: Our first phase of embedded assessments
stories.summary: OpenAI 与 Apollo Research、METR、Transluce 和 Goodfire 启动首阶段嵌入式评估，独立评估模型对齐、安全防护和监控系统。这回应外界对第三方模型评估的需求。
stories.analysis: 嵌入式独立评估可提升透明度，但评估范围和结论公开程度决定其可信度。
stories.sourceExcerpt: OpenAI begins embedded assessments with Apollo Research, METR, and Transluce, and Goodfire to independently evaluate model alignment, safeguards, and monitoring systems.

stories.title: Google Labs 推出 Tabletop：可定制的群组协作空间
stories.sourceTitle: Try Tabletop: Customizable, collaborative spaces for groups to plan, play and do more together.
stories.summary: Google Labs 推出实验产品 Tabletop，让团队创建互动行程、投票和对阵表等协作空间，目前开放候补名单。它面向群体计划和共同决策场景。
stories.analysis: 协作 AI 产品从个人助手转向多人共享空间，Tabletop 是轻量试验。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Tabletop is a new Google Labs experiment for group collaboration. Build interactive itineraries, polls, and brackets with your team. Join the waitlist.

stories.title: Holiday Extras 用 OpenAI 的 dots 主动生成发布报告并提醒问题
stories.sourceTitle: At Holiday Extras, dots get to work before anyone asks
stories.summary: OpenAI 介绍 Holiday Extras 的案例：dots 会在无人要求时生成发布报告、标记可能被忽略的问题，并在通勤时讨论即将到来的会议。它展示主动式 AI 助手的工作流。
stories.analysis: 主动式代理的价值在减少遗漏，但也需明确触发与隐私边界。
stories.sourceExcerpt: Dots deliver launch reports unprompted, flag issues people might miss, and talk through upcoming meetings on the commute to work.

stories.title: 智能体 AI 架构：当前挑战与未来机遇
stories.sourceTitle: 智能体 AI 架构：当前挑战与未来机遇
stories.summary: InfoQ 中文讨论智能体 AI 架构面临的当前挑战与未来机会，聚焦企业落地和系统设计。适合观察中国 AI 产品与工程实践。
stories.analysis: 智能体架构从演示走向生产，可靠性和工具链仍是主要门槛。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 点击查看原文>

stories.title: 昇腾算力训出双榜 SOTA 具身世界模型，华为云开放整套底座
stories.sourceTitle: 昇腾算力训出了双榜SOTA的具身世界模型，华为云这次想把整套底座开放出来
stories.summary: 量子位报道，华为云用昇腾算力训练出在双榜达到 SOTA 的具身世界模型，并计划开放整套底座。国产算力竞争正从芯片性能转向训练效率、数据规模、部署成本和场景落地。
stories.analysis: 开放底座有助于吸引具身智能开发者，但生态粘性取决于工具链和真实场景数据。
stories.sourceExcerpt: 国产算力的成熟，把具身竞争维度从「芯片有多强」，拉入了一个比拼训练效率、数据规模、部署成本和场景落地速度的多维战场。

stories.title: Qwen 发布 Qwen3Guard：面向 Token 流的实时安全防护模型
stories.sourceTitle: Qwen3Guard: Real-time Safety for Your Token Stream
stories.summary: Qwen 推出 Qwen3Guard，这是 Qwen 家族首个安全护栏模型，基于 Qwen3 微调用于安全分类。它面向 token 流的实时安全防护。
stories.analysis: 安全护栏模型化可降低应用侧合规成本，但需平衡误判和延迟。
